command: claude --permission-mode manual (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), with a project-local .claude/settings.json registering PermissionRequest
note: The gate is `PermissionRequest`, NOT `Notification`: the only Notification this run fired was the idle `Claude is waiting for your input`. The composed fixture's belief that a permission arrives as Notification is what let install/claude.rs ship without registering PermissionRequest at all — the decoder has always handled it, the bytes just never arrived. Home path redacted to /Users/dev.
